Changelog"},{"id":"p6s1","text":"> DSH LAN Guard is a DeepSeek Harness community plugin. It registers one section in the official set"},{"id":"p6s2","text":"tings page (`settings.section`), replaces no official layout, and modifies neither DSH source nor DS"},{"id":"p6s3","text":"H's own listen binding."},{"id":"p7s1","text":"DSH serves its Web UI on `127.0.0.1` only, and it deliberately refuses to bind `0.0.0.0`. This plugi"},{"id":"p7s2","text":"n leaves that binding alone and opens a **second, gated** listener on another port, proxying the off"},{"id":"p7s3","text":"icial UI outward as-is: a password gate, self-signed HTTPS by default, a QR code to open it on a pho"},{"id":"p7s4","text":"ne, and device pairing you can approve or block one by one. **One restart after install is all it ta"},{"id":"p7s5","text":"kes** — no hand-written configuration."},{"id":"p8s1","text":"## What it does"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"- **Gated reverse proxy** — relays HTTP and WebSocket end to end (including the official UI's `/api/"},{"id":"p9s2","text":"remote.mux` long connection), rewrites `Host`/`Origin`, strips hop-by-hop headers, and answers `502`"},{"id":"p9s3","text":" when the upstream is down. DSH's own binding and configuration are never touched.
- **LAN-ready by "},{"id":"p9s4","text":"default, but reachable is not the same as enterable** — it binds `0.0.0.0`, so **one restart** after"},{"id":"p9s5","text":" install is enough. The gate is on by default and **refuses every device until you set an access pas"},{"id":"p9s6","text":"sword**, and TLS is self-signed by default — nothing travels in clear. Switch to "this machine only""},{"id":"p9s7","text":" in the settings page if you prefer.
- **Two passwords** — PBKDF2-SHA256 (600,000 iterations). The *"},{"id":"p9s8","text":"*access password** logs visitor devices in; the **admin password** unlocks this settings page's mana"},{"id":"p9s9","text":"gement console (it falls back to the access password). Plus a `dsh_` passwordless link, persistent v"},{"id":"p9s10","text":"isitor sessions, per-IP lockout and CSRF checks.
- **Self-signed HTTPS by default, with a stable CA*"},{"id":"p9s11","text":"* — generates a `DSH LAN Guard CA` and signs a leaf certificate for the current NIC addresses. Chang"},{"id":"p9s12","text":"ing IP only re-signs the leaf, so each device trusts the CA once.

[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"### Why a phone's session socket dies (measured 2026-09-28)"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"## Security boundary"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"- DSH's own listen address is never changed; the plugin modifies no DSH configuration, session data,"},{"id":"p17s2","text":" or official UI.
- **Gate before listener** — the listener only opens after the gate object is const"},{"id":"p17s3","text":"ructed. The LAN-facing default is acceptable precisely because `auth.enabled` defaults to true, **th"},{"id":"p17s4","text":"e gate refuses every non-loopback device while no access password is set**, and TLS defaults to self"},{"id":"p17s5","text":"-signed. All three must hold together.
- Secrets (`secrets.json`, `devices.json`, sessions) live in "},{"id":"p17s6","text":"`dataDir` with mode `600`; passwords are stored only as PBKDF2-SHA256 hashes, a device token is retu"},{"id":"p17s7","text":"rned in plaintext once and only its SHA-256 hash is stored, and **the passwordless-link token is nev"},{"id":"p17s8","text":"er written to logs**.
- The proxy stamps every forwarded request with an unforgeable source marker s"},{"id":"p17s9","text":"o the host can tell "the machine's own operator" from "a visitor through the proxy".
- Loopback acce"},{"id":"p17s10","text":"ss is **physically unlocked by design** — whoever can use this computer could change these settings "},{"id":"p17s11","text":"anyway.
- **The official-settings-page unlock (`settingsUnlock`) is a UI compatibility patch, not a "},{"id":"p17s12","text":"new transport privilege.** A proxied request is already rewritten to a loopback `host`, and DSH's se"},{"id":"p17s13","text":"ttings RPC is gated only by the visitor gate (reads are redacted by DSH); the switch merely stops th"},{"id":"p17s14","text":"e official page from reporting "settings are unavailable in this browser". Turn it off to restore DS"},{"id":"p17s15","text":"H's stock behaviour.
- The access password is **shared**: revoking a device invalidates that device'"},{"id":"p17s16","text":"s identity cookie immediately, but the same browser can re-pair with the password. Permanently block"},{"id":"p17s17","text":"ing one machine would need device fingerprinting or per-device tokens, which this project deliberate"},{"id":"p17s18","text":"ld need device fingerprinting or per-device tokens, which this project deliberately avoids.
